title: QUIC RFC 9000 S13 Periodic ACK-Probe Scheduling Work Item
summary: Close the active-path S13 ACK deadlock/send-scheduling proof gap by proving periodic PING recovery probes and the bounded application send-delay edge.
planned_changes:
- Add focused S13P2P7 requirement-home proof that the recovery PTO fallback emits an ack-eliciting PING probe, not a PADDING-only packet, when no retransmittable payload is available.
- Add negative proof that the PING probe path stays unavailable without an active path and 1-RTT material.
- Add S13-0002 edge proof for the small-packet delay threshold boundary.
- Add canonical x_test_refs and focused architecture/work-item/verification artifacts.
- Keep the existing ACK piggyback policy benchmark suite as the local benchmark guard and add a PING frame formatting case.
verification_plan: Run the focused S13P2P7/S13-0002/S13P2P1-0009 requirement-home filter, run the ACK piggyback policy benchmark harness, regenerate QUIC requirement coverage triage, validate SpecTrace JSON, and check the diff.
completion_notes: Completed as a focused proof and benchmark-guard topoff over the existing active-path recovery PING probe and application-send delay seams.
